crates.name: molla-geometry
crates.purpose_one_line: Collision-detection and mesh-authoring primitive library: broad phase (SAP/BVH/LBVH), narrow phase (hand-rolled pairs + GJK/EPA/MPR), shape-vs-mesh BVH, soft-body BVH/CCD, deformable tet BVH, contact reduction, SDF bake, sparse VDB grid, plus GPU mirrors of the algorithmic kernels.
main_modules: narrow_phase.rs (2399 loc) - hand-rolled sphere/box/plane pairs + SAT box-box, dispatch to gjk/epa
pipeline.rs (1368) - stateful CollisionPipeline + stateless collide(); Stage-15/19/28 GPU backend toggles
hydroelastic.rs (1355) - patch contact model (CPU + inline HydroelasticKernel at :957)
lbvh.rs (1265, gpu) - Karras LBVH broad phase + RadixSortKernel
sparse_grid.rs (1179) - NanoVDB-style Root/Internal/Leaf sparse volume + SparseGridGpu + SparseSdf
top_public_types: GaussianSplat3d and the SH_* / composite_*_cpu family (gaussian_splat.rs)

crates.name: molla-sensors
crates.purpose_one_line: GPU-first sensor models (raycast, lidar, aerial lidar, IMU, contact, frame-transform, tiled camera, dataset annotation, point-cloud IO) that orchestrate molla-kernels dispatches, plus one CPU-only finite-difference raycast adjoint.
main_modules: lidar.rs (1038) - terrestrial + aerial scan models over Raycaster, ScanMetadata multi-return
tiled_camera.rs (733) - tiled depth/colour/normal/albedo camera via CameraRaysKernel+CameraTraceKernel
pointcloud.rs (721) - grid binning, filters, PLY/PTX/XYZ writers (NO external caller)
raycast.rs (468) - Raycaster orchestrating kernels::RaycastKernel + geometry MeshBvhRaycastKernel
raycast_adjoint.rs (402) - CPU FD adjoint for raycast (the ONLY non-gpu-gated module)
camera_post.rs (336) - tone map / WB / gamma / pack helpers

connection_health.summary: Both crates compile-time connect widely but runtime-connect narrowly. molla-geometry is the real dependency: molla-kernels (GPU kernels + LBVH + SparseGridGpu), molla-solvers (vt_ccd/SoftBvh), molla-fem (TetBvh), and molla-sensors (MeshBvh raycast) all consume it in production code. molla-sensors is nearly a leaf: the viewer (through the molla facade) is its only non-test consumer, and five of its nine functional modules have just one consumer each.
connection_health.geometry_health: Healthy core - narrow_phase/pipeline/broad_phase/support/gjk/epa/fusion with lbvh/sparse_grid/hydroelastic are reached from production. The GPU file 'mirrors' are the weak seam: sdf_bake_gpu, self_contact_gpu, soft_ccd_gpu, vbd_ccd_gpu and the geometry-side HydroelasticKernel have no caller outside crates/molla-geometry/tests.
connection_health.sensors_health: Thin. Raycaster/Lidar/AerialLidar/ImuSensor/ContactSensor/TiledCamera/Dataset are all wired into viewer scenes (bin/molla_viewer/src/examples/05,06,07,12,105,106,108). FrameTransformSensor, pointcloud, and (outside tests) raycast_adjoint are not wired to anything but themselves; raycast_adjoint does have one viewer scene (80_warpdiffray.rs).
connection_health.facade_health: crates/molla/src/geometry and crates/molla/src/sensors are pure pub-use forwarding - ~30 shim files of the form 'pub use molla_geometry::<mod>::*'. They add a rename layer and nothing else. Every consumer in the tree reads molla::geometry::/molla::sensors::, never molla_geometry::/molla_sensors::, except molla-kernels and molla-solvers tests which bypass the facade.
